main_text.p: ut dicat:Mediū eius combusi in ipso igne, atq; in prunis eius coxi pane & assaui carnem, quā comedam, & ex residuo eius faciā abominandū idolū, & ante stipitē arbo ris incuruabo me.Itaq; pascit cinerē,& cor suū feduftū inclinat eum (ad id,)ut nō libe ret animam suam,neq; dicat, Nunquid nō mendaciū est in dextera mea? Recordare iftorū Jacob & Israel: quoniā feruus meus es tu: ego formaui te ut sis feruus meus: ideo tu Israel ne obliuiscaris mei.Ego dele ui quasi nubē iniquitates tuas, & quasi nebula peccata tua:reuertere ad me, quoniā redemi te.Laudate cœli, qa fecit Dominus (bona populo suo:)jubilate inferiora terrę, rupite montes in laudē,sylua & omnia ligna eius:quoniam redemit Dominus Jacob,& in Israel magnificabitur.Sic dicit Dominus redemptor tuus,& qui te formauit ex utero: Ego Dominus facio omnia: ego solus extendo cœlos ,& expando terram per memetipsum . Difsipans signa divinatorum ,& stultos faciens ariolos,convertens sapientes retrorsum ,& scientiam eorum infatuans. Ipse suscitat verbum servi sui, & consilium nunciorum suorum perficit:ipse dicit de Jerusalem , Inhabitabitur: & de

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (Ifrael read as Israel, Ifraelis not present). Printed "feduftū" and "iftorū" kept as printed. The word "ciuita-" at the foot right is the catchword, with u/v corrected to "civita-". Page number and running head taken from the top of the page.
